name: CK-MB/cTnI/Myo Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of CK-MB/cTnI/Myo using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: CK-MB/cTnI/Myo Fast Test Kit (Immunofluorescence Assay) is intended for in vitro quantitative determination of CK-MB/cTnI/Myo in serum, plasma or whole blood samples. This test is used as an aid in the clinical diagnosis, prognosis and evaluation of myocardial injury such as Acute Myocardial Infarction (AMI), Unstable Angina, Acute Myocarditis and Acute Coronary Syndrome (ACS).
